- The signed 2026 Renewal Order Form (2026-03-20) doesn't state a seat count.
- The account record (updated 2026-09-30) shows 185 active seats.
- Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) sets the count at 230 seats from 2027-01-01.

Before 261 goes into the tracker, it's worth confirming with Ilse or Thea which figure is settled for the 2026 term.
